extracted_factors.Label: Smallholder Tool Development
extracted_factors.Description: Development of a simplified HCS-HCV Approach toolkit for smallholder farmers to implement no deforestation practices and improve conservation and management at local levels.

extracted_factors.Label: Market Access for Deforestation-Free Smallholders
extracted_factors.Description: Efforts to establish market linkages and access for smallholders committed to no deforestation, with potential collaborations and MoUs with companies like PT Agro Andalan and Musim Mas.

extracted_factors.Label: Incentives and Benefits (I&B) Program
extracted_factors.Description: A program aimed at providing both monetary and non-monetary incentives to communities to encourage forest conservation and enhance economic livelihoods.

extracted_factors.Label: Customary Forest Legality
extracted_factors.Description: The process of obtaining legal recognition for customary forests such as Teringkang in Gunam Village, facilitating long-term conservation efforts.

extracted_factors.Label: HCS Forest and HCV Area Conservation
extracted_factors.Description: The aim to achieve long-term protection and management of high carbon stock forests and high conservation value areas through community engagement and support.
